import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a6a6480c.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Restore the regular color field and the fixed outer frame.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seq = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r < 2:
                out[r][c] = 1
            elif c < 2:
                out[r][c] = 1
            elif r == 2 or c == 2:
                out[r][c] = 4
            elif grid[r][c] == 0:
                # Infer the row's phase from any visible patterned cell.
                candidates = []
                for j, v in enumerate(grid[r]):
                    if j >= 3 and v in seq:
                        candidates.append((seq.index(v) - j) % 5)
                phase = max(set(candidates), key=candidates.count) if candidates else 0
                out[r][c] = seq[(c + phase) % 5]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p.exists(), len(code))
